Dieses Add-on wird zentral unter GLOBAL: This add-on is enabled centrally under GLOBAL.
Aktivierung und KI-Freigabe werden zentr: Activation and AI clearance are managed centrally under GLOBAL.
WICHTIG vor Neuinstallation oder Löschen: IMPORTANT before reinstalling or deleting the instance: create a full export here. It includes admin config, all mappings, vehicle profiles, policies and learning files (price/PV/house load/stats). The file is stored on the host under /opt/iobroker/iobroker-data/ems-runtime.<instance>/exports/backup/ (not a browser download). After a fresh install: place the export into the restore inbox and run Restore in Admin — mappings and learning return. Status only under backup.* (export_register_ready, last_file_name, …).
Diagnose-/Support-Paket (kein Restore):: Diagnostics/support package (not for restore): anonymized system/runtime info including deep wallbox detail JSON and logs — for support and troubleshooting. Stored under /opt/iobroker/iobroker-data/ems-runtime.<instance>/exports/support/ (*.emssupport). Replaces the deep write/feedback contract leaves removed from the object tree.
So starten Sie: 1) Geräte-Mappings setze: How to start: 1) Set device mappings (which ioBroker states EMS may read/write). 2) Keep each device on dryrun until everything looks right. 3) Only then switch to live. dryrun = EMS plans and shows but does not write devices. live = writes allowed. Both global and per-add-on must be live, otherwise it stays dryrun. AI optimization (later) also needs “AI optimization allowed” per add-on.
Der schwere Planner-Shadow/Takeover-Pfad: The heavy planner shadow/takeover path is disabled in this production build. EMS controls via failsafe + daily-plan logic. Later, AI can optimize plans per add-on (with clearance) — without writing devices directly.
